name: current_four_camera_real_counterevidence_input_audit
question: Does actual current4cam sealed E1 supply valid paired farther-depth disputes of historical weak B risk without disputing real static obstacles? No new clearance policy claimed.
baseline: Reuse sealed current4rig SGBM/native pose/B90s; no source regeneration/GT decisions/map edits/physics.
domain: 180 unique active exposure epochs0..179 (policy5*i), terminal180 excluded because no decision; all B risk cells each epoch. Current positive protected. All historical cells scored, including no-anchor/unavailable/occluded. First event policy61/source12 predetermined from v108.
anchor: Latest real measurement per cell/eye, lowest query UID each exposure. Keep real world XYZ, source eye/UID/partner UID/frame and source SHA. Max4 representatives; these do not certify entire cell volume. Update only new actual exposure.
projection: Native640x480 same current F294.77087816197377 and optical USD AX conversion. Nearest pixel; finite front axis range.5..3, in FOV, not CAD, original valid+finite depth.5..3. Use source estimated body at capture; no interpolating stale RGB to policy pose.
classification: Per eye observedZ-anchorZ: <-.2 closer occluder, abs<=.2 compatible, >.2 farther; all other unavailable. Pair: either closer dominates; both compatible; both farther; otherwise mixed/partial or both unavailable. Anchor dispute requires some both-far pair and no compatible/closer pair. Strict main cell requires all stored anchors disputed; any-anchor sensitivity secondary only. No freeing or risk deletion.
margin_provenance: Fixed.2m from old ray_contradiction_memory; heuristic, no pose/error confidence bound. Same pair eyes correlated, no independence/probability claim.

numeric_gates.primary: strict all-anchor only; never choose secondary by teacher score

stop: Any identity/causal assertion error stops; one implementation-only recovery max; no parameter sweep. If necessary gates fail or mechanism repeats old, do not install memory repair or navigate.

old_comparison.ray_contradiction_memory.py: Already projected old MODEL cores to new source endpoints and farther>.2, candidate dispute only. Current audit is changed actual input domain/provenance, not a new algorithm.
old_comparison.current_stereo_memory_ray_v2.py: Already distinguishes contradiction/occlusion/compatible with heuristic sigma margin; returns clear_memory=False. Dense paired current4rig audit does not create clearance certificate.
